name: Hoplitosuchus
isnote: Based on osteoderms that cannot be identified closely; no finer placement within the aetosaurs.
sum: Hoplitosuchus is an aetosaur known from osteoderms of the Late Triassic Santa Maria Formation of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Osteoderms from the Santa Maria Formation, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, described by von Huene (1942); catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: The holotype osteoderms, which the Wikipedia lead describes as unidentifiable.
biology: The sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Huene 1942
